title: Needle
description: A turntable seen from above with Revolver on the platter and side one listed beside it. Scratch it forwards and backwards, let go and the platter pulls it back up to 33⅓, lift the tonearm and drop it anywhere to cue, or pick a track and the arm cues its band.
intent: One music object finished to the edge: the record is the transport, so the hand on the vinyl is the playhead, and the seven bands cut into the side are the seven tracks you can cue.
